en-GB.description: The Nextcloud Desktop Client is a tool to synchronise files from Nextcloud Server with your computer.
en-GB.longDescription: Use the desktop clients to keep your files synchronised between your Nextcloud server and your desktop. Select one or more directories on your local machine and always have access to your latest files wherever you are.
en-GB.name: Nextcloud
